I have successfully updated the URL regex in `rich/highlighter.py` to allow the tilde character `~`. I verified the fix with a reproduction script and ensured that no test files were modified in the final submission.

The issue was that the URL regex in `rich/highlighter.py` did not include the tilde (`~`) character, which caused URLs containing tildes to be partially highlighted or not highlighted at all. I updated the regex to include `~` in the allowed character set for URLs.

**Changes:**
- Modified `rich/highlighter.py`: Added `~` to the character class of the `url` regex.

**Verification:**
- Created a reproduction script that confirmed the URL `https://example.org/~user` was only partially highlighted (up to the tilde) before the fix, and fully highlighted after the fix.
- Verified that the change does not break existing highlighter tests.
